title: Tax in the Reporting Close
summary: A practical guide to managing current tax, deferred tax, effective tax rate reconciliation, and uncertain tax positions during the financial close process.

steps.title: Accounting for Uncertain Tax Positions
steps.summary: Assess and disclose uncertain tax positions in accordance with accounting standards.

steps.title: Integrating Tax Reporting into the Close Process
steps.summary: Coordinate tax data and disclosures effectively within the overall financial close timeline.
